notes.title: Sweet Pea full release
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38657123/60cebe91cf6ff2aceb8791563413883994a8a251.gif[/img]

Sweet Pea is now in full release! With almost two years of work I am so happy Sweet Pea has made it this far! This is not the end however! I will continue to improve and refine all aspects of the game as well as some nice surprises planned for the future!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38657123/1dedbadfe09bd880d06afd7df67cf2572a17cdc2.gif[/img]

Thank you for taking the time to try Sweet Pea! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38657123/e571197d217958386565a43e049a0820998ca1b1.png[/img]

notes.title: Control Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38657123/60cebe91cf6ff2aceb8791563413883994a8a251.gif[/img]

With the Control Update we see full controller support, tutorials to help new players, a more advanced photo mode with pan/zoom settings and filters, and much more! Also Sweet Pea will be going into full release on April 13th!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38657123/cf98090ab35402f900f7aaddbfe2944f771964a8.gif[/img]

Added Controller support for the entire game

Added Photo mode improvements with Pan/Zoom and filters

Added New tutorial info in the first zone

Added assets and atmospheric effects in the Forgotten Bog

Added New UI elements for controller support 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38657123/96f4f63a7474fb8ca7bdb135aa2efd191e4261a9.gif[/img]

Reworked Controller/mouse/keyboard input system 

Reworked Osiris end fight zone to be a bit less chaotic

Reworked Bat placement in all crystal cavern zones

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38657123/8d80924393d3c362f83ccae36bfcf7433af9db48.gif[/img]

notes.title: Sweet Pea: Akena update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38657123/29d2b59941eb6fea8cf298d6f534ad6d14aecbf1.png[/img]

The Akena update brings a new boss "Akena". A large aquatic guardian with some serious anger issues that can be found in the Tributary near Pine Meadows. Best off to run at this point but Akena will be back for more. On top of Akena a later boss has be named Osiris! Who dwells deep in the Crystal Caverns. Also a number of fixes and adjustments have be implemented.  


[b]Added [/b]Akena intro and chase. Sound AI and basic behavior pass

[b]Added[/b] Osiris title shot and AI adjustments (Less aggressive)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38657123/a9eb5a1530dbd5226ccc58f3bc1cf57af2c8c270.png[/img]

[b]Adjusted[/b] Foreground objects have again been tweaked to better allow player visibility

[b]Adjusted[/b]  Burst force and animation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38657123/e2bac9a8d3d259e9d61eb30feb5bc71db9e9f216.png[/img]

[b]Fixed[/b]  Occlusion issue in menu system and cameras fade in/outs   

[b]Fixed[/b] Time scale state getting stuck when player is in a specific proximity to a pop berry's force push

[b]Fixed[/b] Intro skip trigger not working after first shot

[b]Fixed [/b] Ghost platforms in the Crystal Caverns and Asimov Castle   

[b]There is more to come[/b]. Stay safe everybody and t[u]hank you for playing Sweet Pea!!![/u]

notes.title: The first Sweet Pea update is here!!!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38657123/a9c36de01a9b46e5843136d129b1fca084b89d53.png[/img]

[b]The first Sweet Pea update is here!!![/b]
This is  in large part a quality of life one  with many bug fixes that should greatly improve the player experience.

[b]Fixed[/b] collision issue making menu inaccessible.

[b]Fixed[/b] layer overlap stopping players from switching menu panels.

[b]Fixed[/b] animation not playing in Gunther intro and chase.

[b]Fixed[/b] UI animation not parenting properly.

[b]Adjusted[/b] Ice/Leaf wings range of effect as well as an increase in burst force. 

[b]Adjusted[/b] Ability's cross over to only include cosmetics. Giving greater player control.

[b]Adjusted[/b] Foreground assets to allow better play visibility.

[b]Adjusted[/b] Dynamic camera reaction time to maintain speed with Sweet Pea.

This is small update, but should help Sweet Pea continue to be built upon while maintaining a smooth experience for early access players. More will come soon. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38657123/8874c6531cde034a64b79cc4b9985955392c7b76.png[/img]
